verdict.rationale: New Relic's public pricing page documents a perpetual free tier with 100 GB/month of included data ingest, so some pricing is published without a sales conversation. The pack shows no per-GB rates, per-signal breakdown, user-seat prices or cost calculator, so the evidence does not let an SRE predict a bill. Community reports of default-on log collection billed at the standard rate and confusing per-environment and per-user billing suggest predictability is weak in practice, though they do not show the pricing is unpublished. Missing for 10: published per-GB ingest rates, per-signal (logs/metrics/traces) price breakdown, published user/seat pricing, a cost estimator, and independent confirmation that bills can be predicted without contacting sales.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: Sign up for free access with our perpetual free tier and 100 GB/month of data ingest included.
